sourceRefs.locator: Annal for 867. The entry names the rival kings, describes fighting inside and outside York and reports the final peace.

Rollason, historical sources, the capture in 866–867 and Northumbrian councillors; Blackburn, coinage under Olaf, fig. 82.2 and discussion of the Raven issue under the two Olafs. Craft synthesis, 16–22 Coppergate, pp. 476–481.

labels.de: Die beiden Könige fallen in York
labels.en: Two Northumbrian kings die at York

note.de: Osberht und Ælle fielen im März beim Kampf um York. Der Punkt bezeichnet die Stadt. Der Durchbruch lässt sich keinem bestimmten Tor zuweisen.
note.en: Osberht and Ælle died in the fighting at York in March. The marker identifies the city. The account does not locate the breach at a particular gate.
